camera.notes: Return RGBFrame or the strict SponsorRGBSource mapping.

context.notes: Optional separate source for workspace/geometry facts if the camera callback does not include them.

inference.notes: Use event-provided OpenVINO/Anomalib artifacts without changing the authority core.

planner.notes: Return explicit action_type, object_id, target_bin, speed_mps and trajectory.

actuator.notes: Return explicit status and the exact action_id. No implicit success.

stop.notes: Document the actual stop mechanism onsite before safe-interruption proof.
